title: feat(chatbot): granular 确认修改 (confirm-change) card
body:
Mirrors the `propose_blueprint` plan card, for **granular** metadata edits.

When a mutating tool returns `{ status: 'changes_proposed', changes, summary }` (the cloud confirm-before-change gate's preview), `detectProposedChanges` lifts it and `ChatbotEnhanced` renders a 确认改动 card with 确认修改 / 调整 buttons. The 确认修改 click sends an approval message the cloud gate recognises; the agent then applies. **Nothing changes until confirmed.**

Reuses the existing plan-card pattern (icons, button styles, positional "已确认" badge). Built clean (42/42 workspace build).

Part of a 3-repo change (coupled): cloud `feat/confirm-before-build` + framework `feat/tool-ctx-user-message`.
